name: Stripe Payment Gateway
description: Generic Stripe checkout for any Kohevo plugin (v1.2). Exposes StripePaymentAPI::createCheckout(lineItems, opts) so plugins don't need their own Stripe wiring. Fires a stripe_webhook_event action so consumers can react to events. Includes a Charges admin page with refund support and a test/live mode toggle. Registers Stripe as a gateway of the shared payment layer; Terminal readers and the on-page Payment Element stay Stripe-only.
author: Kohevo

permissions.label: Manage Stripe gateway settings and API credentials
View Stripe charges and issue refunds
